name: 53218 · Milwaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53218 (Milwaukee) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (52% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53218 (Milwaukee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 53218 (Milwaukee) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
